source_caption:
Maybe happiness isn’t what you believe, but who you believe. 

This exchange from Fleabag is a masterclass in the difference between "being right" and "being happy." While the world tells us that happiness is a prize we win through suffering and facing our consequences, Fleabag reminds us that it’s actually much simpler and much harder.

It’s not just about the philosophies we follow or the rules we set for ourselves. It’s also about the people we choose to trust. In a world obsessed with self-improvement and "facing who you are," sometimes the only route to actual happiness isn’t just doing the work alone… but having someone who truly believes in you.
